name: Covenant
overview: The concept of covenant in Scripture is revealed through God’s direct commands and promises, as seen in His instructions to Adam regarding the tree of life and the knowledge of good and evil, where obedience was tied to life and death. After the flood, God established a covenant with Noah and his descendants, blessing them and commanding fruitfulness, signifying a binding and sacred relationship. These early examples highlight that covenants involve clear divine directives and commitments that extend to represented parties, underscoring their binding and sacred nature.
